When the to-do list looks like a mountain, don’t climb the whole thing.
Just pick the tiniest step. Then the next one ♡

Puchi & Chika · Episode 2: The To-Do Mountain

What’s one tiny thing on your list today? We’ll cheer for you ↓

#puchika #littlewins #productivity #pixelart #gentlereminder

Not every win has to be big. These all count:

1. You got out of bed
2. You drank a glass of water
3. You stepped outside
4. You replied to that message
5. You ate a real meal
6. You rested

Save this for a hard day ♡ Which one did you do today?
